request.name: Get providers that match a job's specialization

description.content:
This endpoint supports 3 tabs in the ui:

All:
- Cln's Specializations match the job, expanded by specialty matrix
- Uses token-based pagination (search_before/search_after)
- Sorted by apply intent score by default

"My Matching Clinicians":
- Clinicians claimed by the requesting PN

"Unclaimed Matching Clinicians":
- Clinicians not claimed by any PN
- At least minimum qualified for the job
- Capped at 25 records (no pagination)

"Claimed Matching Clinicians" - this UI is used by PN Managers and AMs:
- Clinicians claimed by ANY PN
- At least minimum qualified for the job

Note about the claimed filter:
*** this maps to claimed BY THE AUTHED CALLER, not claimed BY ANY PN ***
